career_ladder.note: Village Development Officers (Gram Vikas Adhikari, formerly Gram Sevak) serve as the ex-officio Secretary to Gram Panchayats under the Rural Development & Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Rajasthan. They administer grassroots development schemes, implement MGNREGA works, manage Panchayat budgets, and maintain village birth, death, and asset registries.

exam_scheme.note: The Village Development Officer recruitment comprises a two-stage examination: a Preliminary screening test followed by a Main competitive written examination and document verification. In the Main examination, 1/3rd mark is deducted for each incorrect answer.

financial_package.note: Village Development Officers are remunerated in Pay Matrix Level L-6 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,800) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹15,100 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹21,500 is drawn.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Level L-6 Schedule
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level L-6 entry basic pay of ₹21,500 at 58% DA (₹12,470 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹1,935 to ₹3,870), rural panchayat touring allowance, net of State Insurance, General Provident Fund, and RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting classification
Rural travel allowance and official inspection conveyance reimbursement
Cashless medical facility under Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS)
Defined pension coverage under restored Old Pension Scheme (OPS)
Annual earned leave, casual leave, and leave travel concession (LTC)
